EC1: Patients undergoing bilateral hip [OR] or knee replacement;
EC2: Patients undergoing total  hip [OR] or knee replacement who have been enrolled in this study for a prior hip or knee replacement;
EC3: Patients who are concurrently enrolled in another active interventional clinical trial testing a drug or intervention known or believed to interact with aspirin, warfarin, or rivaroxaban;
EC4: Patients who have a contraindication to two or more of the three study prophylaxis regimens;
EC5: Women who are pregnant or breastfeeding, as well as those of reproductive potential unless there is a negative urine pregnancy test on the day of surgery;
EC6: Patients on chronic (longer than the prior 6 months) anticoagulation [NOT] other than with antiplatelet medications;
EC7: Patients with documented gastrointestinal [OR], cerebral [OR], or other hemorrhage within 3 months of the operation;
EC8: Patients with a known diagnosis of defective hemostasis and past history of clinical bleeding requiring transfusion and treatment;
EC9: Patients who have had an operative procedure involving the eye [OR], ear [OR], or central nervous system within one month;
EC10: Patients with severe uncontrolled hypertension with systolic BP  > 220mmHg [OR] or diastolic BP > 120mmHg;
EC11: Patients with an absolute body weight of less than 41 kilograms (90.4 lbs) at baseline visit;
EC12: Vulnerable patient populations including prisoners [OR] and institutionalized individuals.
